name: UWC
recent: UWC 于2026年10月启动最多5%新股配售计划，并已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市。最新季度（截至2026年7月31日）营收与净利同比大幅增长。
notable: 190,955股新股（占已发行股份最多5%），已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市。
截至2026年7月31日季度净利同比增长129.7%，营收同比增长71.1%。
risks: 配售新股最多5%可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
earnings: 2026年7月31日止季度营收为186,177,000令吉，净利为37,598,000令吉，净利率20.2%；营收环比增长22.9%，净利环比增长42.9%，营收同比增长71.1%，净利同比增长129.7%。

recent_en: UWC launched a placement of up to 5% new shares in October 2026 and has received Bursa Securities approval for listing. Latest quarter (ended 31 July 2026) saw strong year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Proposed placement of up to 55,190,955 new shares (up to 5% of issued shares), with listing approved by Bursa Securities.
Net profit for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 rose 129.7% year-on-year, with revenue up 71.1%.
risks_en: The placement of up to 5% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR186,177,000 and net profit was MYR37,598,000, with a net margin of 20.2%; revenue grew 22.9% QoQ and net profit 42.9% QoQ, while revenue rose 71.1% YoY and net profit 129.7% YoY.
